It has one more blade than the Lizal boomerang to give it additional cutting power, and it still returns when thrown.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 24 |durability = 25 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lizal Forked Boomerang}} Lizal Forked Boomerangs are [[Weapon]]s favored by [[Blue Lizalfos]]. This is common among pieces of [[Lizalfos Gear]], an equipment archetype that includes all Weapons created and utilized by Lizalfos.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} They are also used by some [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]], [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]], and [[Electric Lizalfos]]. They have one more blade than a regular [[Lizal Boomerang]], but they are still capable of returning when thrown. Therefore, [[Link]] should make sure to catch any thrown Lizal Forked Boomerangs before they hit him. They are commonly found in [[Lizalfos]] [[Monster Stronghold]]s in the [[Gerudo Desert]] and the [[Tabantha Frontier]]. Since they are made of metal, Lizal Forked Boomerangs will attract [[Lightning]] and therefore can be dangerous to equip during [[Thunderstorm]]s. This also means that they are capable of conducting [[Electricity]]. In addition, Lizal Forked Boomerangs can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]], but they sink when they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]].
